description: Readable ratchet — `readable` style findings per (file, rule) may only DECREASE, and a file not listed here must have none. Checked by `bun scripts/check-pyreon-lint-ratchet.ts` (validate-fast + CI). Fix new findings with `bunx pyreon-lint --fix <file>` (the spacing rules are autofixable), then tighten with `bun scripts/check-readable-ratchet.ts --update`. Never raise a count to absorb a finding.
